customers.evidence: reaching customers wherever they are and innovating new tastes and choices, while staying true to customer favorites

employees.evidence: Building on our commitments to our people

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, brand-forward tone with first-person plural voice ('we're proud'). Customers lead the framing, with innovation and product choice emphasized. Stakeholder commitments to people, communities and world appear only as a brief closing phrase. Commitments are stated absolutely but are vague, with no metrics or specific targets.
